about_the_game:
Play as a dark magician, gather your party of all sorts of evil, unspeakable creatures and spread darkness! A turn-based rogue-like experience with dark humour elements! Sacrifice your enemies to Evil Gods, gain powers and upgrade your Tower of Darkness to spread corruption throughout the continent.

Are you tired of being the good guy, saving the world or helping the community? Okay! It's time to step into the Tower of Darkness and embrace the evil within you! Become an Apprentice of Darkness and spread terror throughout the lands!

                                     CHOOSE YOUR CHARACTER & WAR GROUP

Choose your main character! Be a Fearsome Warlock or a Seductive Sorceress and defeat your enemies by using your Dark Magic! Also don't forget to summon the creatures of darkness into your war group!

                                         FIGHT IN TURN-BASED BATTLES

Go to the lands of the hypocrites and fight in turn-based battles to conquer them! Use tactics, take advantage of the land, or use your passive skills to overcome your enemies!

                       DEFEAT OR SACRIFICE YOUR ENEMIES IN FUN WAYS

If you are successful in the battles, you can add your enemies into the sacrifice list or kill them right in the battlefield to heal your recruits! If you sacrifice them you will get Darkness Points to unlock new powers or summon new recruits! Funniest ritualistic sacrifices you have ever seen!

                              IT GETS DIFFICULT AS THE SEASONS CHANGE

Every 5 battles the seasons change, and the Tier of the enemies increase so they get stronger, while also encountering new enemies! But don't worry darkness always wins huh? Eheheh...

                               UPGRADE YOUR TOWER OF DARKNESS

  • As seasons change every 5 battle and enemies get stronger, your Tower of Darkness also upgrades and gets a new floor! With every new floor, you get to choose between 3 different powers or unlocking a new creature of darkness!

                A TURN-BASED ROGUE-LIKE EXPERIENCE IN A DARK FANTASY

  • If you lose a certain number of battles, you will lose an upgrade floor on your Tower of Darkness, if you lose all your floors your Tower of Darkness will collapse and you will start from the beginning! You may lose, but you don't have to give up!

content_descriptors.notes: Everything in this game is for purely entertainment content, no deliberate hate or harm is intended to any groups that might be associated within this game.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: OSX 10.14 Mojave (64-bit)
  • Processor: 32nm CPU (7th Gen or newer)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GT 550 or AMD Radeon HD 5000 - Integrated GPUs might not work
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
